overview: Research draft record, unpublished: every statement below is an unverified lead, not a verified fact. A university in Kharkiv, Ukraine, specialising in pharmacy, whose foreign applicants are handled by a Faculty for Foreign Citizens' Education. No Medicine or Dentistry programme was found: the leads concern Pharmacy and related programmes only. This draft is gated on operating conditions: Kharkiv is wartime-affected, and nothing in this record may be published until a dated official statement says whether, where and how foreign students are taught in the current academic year. Draft record built from search-result leads on 2026-10-12: the latest official fee schedule found covers 2025-2026, so no fee is recorded. Every field below is awaiting verification against the official pages listed under research references and nothing here is presented as a current fact.

accreditation.note: Record accreditation only from a NAQA register entry or the official accreditation certificate as the source. Leads only: the Dean of the Faculty for Foreign Citizens' Education page (en.nuph.edu.ua/?p=953, undated) invites students to continue in the university's "accredited specialties" (paraphrase) — a SELF-CLAIM naming no accrediting body, decision or expiry date; it is not a NAQA record. Third-party wording that the NUPh Professional College is a state institution of "I-II levels of accreditation" concerns the college, not the university, and is the legacy institutional-level wording, not NAQA programme accreditation; a 2023-2024 college programme document is an internal development document, not an accreditation decision. A NAQA "Pharmacy" decision PDF hosted by a Lviv university could not be attributed to this university and is excluded. Keep separate: institutional registration (EDEBO register entry), the programme licence (Ministry of Education and Science licence record), NAQA programme accreditation, international accreditation, and destination-country recognition. No EDEBO entry, licence record, NAQA record or international accreditation was returned (an access/search limitation, not evidence of absence). The Study in Ukraine portal listing (ID 41) is a directory listing and is none of these.

recognition.note: Recognition is decided separately by each destination country's regulator. Record it only from a tier-4 page on a recognition-authority host the owner has listed (N24 b; none listed yet), quoting what that page says, with its date. A World Directory of Medical Schools (WDOMS) listing is a directory entry, not recognition; a university's own claim of WHO, NMC or ECFMG recognition is not recognition; an international accreditation is not recognition. Institutional registration (EDEBO), the programme licence and programme accreditation (NAQA) are separate claims. No recognition claim was found for this university in this round, and WDOMS status was not checked. Never imply a right to practise or to register in any country.
